answer_1.quote: We propose the new research problem of fewshot natural language generation... We crawl multi-domain table-to-text data from Wikipedia as our training/test instances.
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural language descriptions (sentences) from semi-structured tables

answer_2.quote: we first conduct automatic evaluations using BLEU-4, shown in Table... The ROUGE-4 (F-measure) results follow the same trend with BLEU-4 results

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluation studies using Amazon Mechanical Turk, based on two aspects: Factual correctness and Language naturalness. The first study attempts to evaluate how well the generated text correctly conveys information in the table, by counting the number of facts in the text supported by the table, and contradicting with or missing from the table.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assess (1) factual correctness by counting supporting and contradicting facts, and (2) language naturalness via pairwise comparisons of fluency and grammaticality.
